blocks.text: Hal-pazeeri (solvability) aur pecheedgi (complexity) batati hain ke masla algorithm se hal ho sakta hai ya nahi, aur ho sakta hai to kitni kaarkardagi se. Yeh hissa hal-pazeer aur na-qabil-e-hal, aur tractable aur intractable masail mein farq karta aur computational complexity ki bunyad rakhta hai.

blocks.prompt: Yeh hissa kisi masle ke baare mein kaunse do sawal poochta hai?
blocks.explanation: Kya koi algorithm ise hal kar sakta hai (solvability), aur kitni kaarkardagi se (complexity)?

items: Pehle poochein masla hal-pazeer hai, phir kitni kaarkardagi se: solvable/unsolvable, tractable/intractable.
